title.value: Chunked Autoregressive GAN for Conditional Waveform Synthesis
title.justification: The title is clearly stated in the header of the paper, indicating the focus on using Chunked Autoregressive GAN for waveform synthesis.
title.quote: C HUNKED A UTOREGRESSIVE GAN FOR C ONDITIONAL W AVEFORM S YNTHESIS

analysis.description: The paper presents a novel model, Chunked Autoregressive GAN (CARGAN), designed for conditional waveform synthesis. CARGAN aims to improve synthesis quality by using autoregression as an inductive bias for learning pitch and phase relationships. The model is evaluated against existing GAN-based methods, demonstrating improvements in pitch accuracy, training time, and subjective quality. It is suitable for real-time or interactive applications.

type.justification: The paper conducts experiments comparing CARGAN with existing models, provides quantitative metrics like pitch and periodicity errors, and performs subjective listening tests.
type.quote: We perform spectrogram-to-waveform inversion on speech (Section 5.2), and show that CARGAN produces better pitch accuracy, better subjective quality, faster training time, and reduced memory consumption during training.

name.justification: The paper is centered on generating audio waveforms using deep learning models, specifically focusing on waveform synthesis from conditional inputs such as mel-spectrograms.
name.quote: Conditional audio waveform generation has seen remarkable improvements in fidelity and com- putational cost in recent years, benefiting applications such as text-to-speech, voice editing, and controllable music generation.

name.justification: The focus is on improving waveform synthesis using a GAN-based model, explicitly comparing it to other GAN methods like HiFi-GAN.
name.quote: State-of-the-art GAN-based waveform synthesis models...demonstrate impressive subjective quality and generation speed, but exhibit pitch inaccuracy.

name.justification: The paper targets applications like text-to-speech and evaluates its model using speech datasets.
name.quote: We train on the VCTK dataset... and evaluate on both VCTK and DAPS.

name.justification: CARGAN is a hybrid model employing both autoregressive and GAN elements for waveform synthesis.
name.quote: In this work, we present Chunked Autoregressive GAN (CARGAN), a hybrid GAN-based model for conditional waveform synthesis.

name.justification: It is the primary model proposed in the paper offering improved pitch accuracy and training efficiency in waveform synthesis.
name.quote: Relative to prior state-of-the-art GAN-based models, our proposed model, Chunked Autoregressive GAN (CARGAN) reduces pitch error by 40-60%.

is_contributed.justification: The paper introduces CARGAN as a novel approach for conditional waveform synthesis, specifically improving upon previous models.
is_contributed.quote: In this work, we present Chunked Autoregressive GAN (CARGAN), a hybrid GAN-based model for conditional waveform synthesis.

is_executed.justification: The paper includes experiments and results demonstrating the execution of CARGAN on specific datasets.
is_executed.quote: We perform spectrogram-to-waveform inversion on speech (Section 5.2), and show that CARGAN produces better pitch accuracy.

is_compared.justification: CARGAN is compared with various other models like HiFi-GAN across multiple metrics such as pitch accuracy, training time, and subjective quality.
is_compared.quote: Relative to prior state-of-the-art GAN-based models, our proposed model, Chunked Autoregressive GAN (CARGAN) reduces pitch error by 40-60%.

referenced_paper_title.justification: The model is new and introduced in this paper; hence there isn't a reference paper title.
referenced_paper_title.quote: In this work, we present Chunked Autoregressive GAN (CARGAN), a hybrid GAN-based model for conditional waveform synthesis.

name.justification: HiFi-GAN is used as a baseline model for comparison against CARGAN.
name.quote: State-of-the-art GAN-based waveform synthesis models, such as HiFi-GAN, demonstrate impressive subjective quality and generation speed.

is_contributed.justification: HiFi-GAN is discussed and evaluated as a baseline model but is not a contribution of this paper.
is_contributed.quote: State-of-the-art GAN-based waveform synthesis models, such as HiFi-GAN, demonstrate impressive subjective quality and generation speed.

is_executed.justification: HiFi-GAN is utilized for benchmarking and comparison in the experiments.
is_executed.quote: We trained HiFi-GAN (V1) on the VCTK dataset and evaluated the pitch accuracy.

is_compared.justification: The paper compares HiFi-GAN's performance across various metrics such as pitch accuracy and periodicity against CARGAN.
is_compared.quote: ...HiFi-GAN has an average error of 65.8 cents and CARGAN obtains an error of 15.1 cents.

referenced_paper_title.value: HiFi-GAN: Generative Adversarial Networks for Efficient and High Fidelity Speech Synthesis
referenced_paper_title.justification: HiFi-GAN is cited as a prior model for comparison purposes.
referenced_paper_title.quote: Jungil Kong, Jaehyeon Kim, and Jaekyoung Bae. Hifi-gan: Generative adversarial networks for efficient and high fidelity speech synthesis. arXiv preprint arXiv:2010.05646, 2020.

name.justification: VCTK is used for training and evaluation of the GAN models presented in the paper.
name.quote: We train on the VCTK dataset and evaluate the pitch accuracy on 256 randomly selected sentences from a validation set containing speakers seen during training.

name.justification: Torchcrepe is used for extracting pitch and periodicity features from an audio waveform in this study.
name.quote: We use torchcrepe (Morrison, 2020) to extract pitch and periodicity features from an audio waveform.

referenced_paper_title.justification: Torchcrepe is likely a library released alongside prior works by one of the authors, Morrison, limiting available formal titles.
